name: Yumeno Himiko
source:
"Erm… magic exists. I know because… I’m a mage."

Insisting that her parlor tricks are magic, prior to being revised to the SHSL Magician, she was the self-proclaimed SHSL Mage. She claims that she was the youngest person ever chosen by the world magic lovers’ society, The Magician’s Castle, as the Magician of the Year, but she has been prevented from receiving her reward because of a conspiracy to hide the existence of magic. While she isn’t recognized as a mage, she is awash in clients from all over the world who want to hire her as a magician.

Though she's a magician with first class skills, she finds putting in the maximum effort to be too much trouble.. She has high-level sleight of hand techniques and can find someone’s card or coin, or make doves appear, either through illusion or magic. Because she claims to be the SHSL Mage instead, she also speaks like some kind of a real mage from an RPG.

[From [url=http://jinjojess.tumblr.com/post/154672497678/ndrv3-character-bios-from-the-website-4]jinjojess' translation[/url]]
